comment: Per-runtime gzipped size ceilings for the Chio TypeScript SDK. Most entries pin the wasm artifact; the passkey entry pins the package's compiled JS bundle because the package ships no wasm. The size-budget.sh wrapper iterates this table, gzips each declared artifact, and fails the build if any entry exceeds its ceiling. Missing artifacts soft-skip when wasm-pack or tsc has not been run yet.

browser.rationale: < 300 KB gzipped for the browser tarball; wasm artifact dominates the tarball size.

workers.rationale: Cloudflare Workers compressed bundle limit is 3 MB; we hold the SDK wasm contribution to 350 KB to leave 650 KB headroom inside the 1 MB self-imposed total.

edge.rationale: Vercel Edge Function bundle limit is 1 MB compressed; SDK wasm contribution capped at 350 KB to leave room for user code.

deno.rationale: Deno Deploy isolate limit is 50 MB; ceiling kept at 400 KB to bound cold-start cost rather than fit a hard limit.

passkey.rationale: Thin call site (navigator.credentials.get + fetch + parseCapabilityToken). The package ships zero wasm; the gate measures the gzipped TypeScript build output to bound cold-start cost. 30 KB sits well inside the cross-package ceilings (300 KB browser / 350 KB workers) so the budget fires cleanly without bumping totals. If this entry trips, the package is doing too much.
